title: Honesty policy: the docs' uncertainty rules as a machine-checkable list
how_to_read: Each rule fires when any of its triggers holds. A trigger is a predicate on one fact card (all listed field tests must hold on the same card), a regex on the user's question, a regex on the drafted answer, or a cross-card era test.
A fired active rule passes when every required_wording group has at least one match in the answer and no forbidden_claim pattern matches. Regexes are case-insensitive.
A rule with status pending_ruling is reported as pending when it fires; it neither passes nor fails an answer until the owner rules.
Caveat codes on a card (AI-01's caveats field) are the rule codes below. Field triggers are a fallback for cards that do not yet carry the code.
Every rule cites the source lines it came from. sources.node.test.ts fails when a cited line no longer contains its quote, so a docs change shows up as a policy change.

kinds.no_data: The app has no data for that.
kinds.low_confidence: Low-confidence or provisional model outputs and calibrations.
kinds.graded_below_pass: Metrics or ratings graded below pass.
kinds.open_ruling: Claim limits set by an open or unfinished ruling.
kinds.pending_ruling: A rule the docs cannot finish without an owner ruling.

contradictions.topic: Sao Paulo 2021: what the decomposition attributes Hamilton's advantage to

claims.quote: contradiction noted (HAM advantage is car/strategy, not 'brilliant driving')
a margin the model assigns almost entirely to the unexplained residual, not to the tyre or the car

contradictions.note: The fixes log says car/strategy; the page says the gap sits in the unexplained residual, with the car worth 0.15-0.19 s a lap. No rule depends on either reading. Recorded, not resolved.

The landed note (2026-09-28) says MARGINAL; the docs (2026-10-03 build) say PASS. The AI-02 WI doc repeats 'car leakage marginal'. VALIDATION_GRADE_BELOW_PASS triggers on the card's grade field, so it follows whichever value AI-01 publishes.
Fixes log (2026-09-30 dev-final) says PASS; the docs (2026-10-03 build) say FAIL with CI [1.043, 2.673]. The docs' FAIL is what suppresses pure pace.

contradictions.topic: How many circuits are flagged REVIEW_REQUIRED

claims.quote: Currently **1 of 44 circuits** carries a `REVIEW_REQUIRED` flag on weight penalty calibration

contradictions.note: The docs count 1 of 44 because they read the shipped seed, where only Spain is REVIEW_REQUIRED and the other 43 are SKIPPED. The fixes log counts 30 because it reports the verdicts of the post-join-fix calibration run across all 44 circuits (OK 1, REVIEW_REQUIRED 30, INSUFFICIENT_DATA 13), which the seed does not record. Recorded, not resolved. CALIBRATION_FLAGGED_CIRCUIT reads the card's flag, not either count.

contradictions.topic: Which eras pure pace is fitted in

claims.quote: pure pace should not be compared across eras (2018, 2019–2021, 2022–2025)

contradictions.note: Three eras on one line, two on the next. PURE_PACE_WITHIN_ERA uses the three-era split, which is the stricter one.
